stem: The length, in centimeters, of a spring when an object with a mass of \(x\) grams hangs from it is given by \(L(x) = 0.2x + 15\). What is the length, in centimeters, of the spring when an object with a mass of 30 grams hangs from it?
verify:
x = symbols('x')
ans = (Rational(1, 5)*x + 15).subs(x, 30)
assert ans == 21
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [ans]
